data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for lazy Wrap-style layouts with fixed or variable item sizes.
data.what_it_does: lazy_wrap brings lazy rendering to wrap-like Flutter layouts. It allows displaying large collections of chips, tags, cards, and tiles without eagerly building every child by offering fixed and dynamic rendering modes.
use_when: You have large collections of chips, tags, or cards arranged in a wrap layout.
You need lazy rendering for wrap-like layouts with either fixed or variable item dimensions.
avoid_when: You are looking for standard grid or vertical lists where GridView.builder or ListView.builder suffice.
You need complex multi-axis scroll behaviors outside of standard wrap orientations.
strengths: Supports both fixed and dynamic item sizes.
Improves performance over eager building for large collections of wrap items.
Offers offstage measurement and optional fade-in animations for dynamic items.
weaknesses: Dynamic mode requires offstage measurement passes or experimental sliver implementations.
Changing layout revisions can reset the internal scroll position if using the internal controller.

alternatives.name: flutter_staggered_grid_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides advanced staggered grid layouts if you need complex grid arrangements instead of a simple wrap.
